title: Equation-level reconstruction of Schaap and van Genuchten 2006 MMVG and separation from NHI simplification

primary_source.citation: Schaap MG, van Genuchten MT (2006), A Modified Mualem-van Genuchten Formulation for Improved Description of the Hydraulic Conductivity Near Saturation, Vadose Zone Journal 5(1):27-34

notation.h: pressure head, cm; negative below saturation
notation.theta_m: fictitious extrapolated water-content parameter greater than theta_s
notation.h_s: minimum capillary height / air-entry head, negative
notation.K_o: matrix-flow conductivity matching point used by modified Mualem relation

published_equations.name: modified_retention
published_equations.role: introduces a finite air-entry plateau while preserving measurable theta_s

published_equations.name: modified_mualem_matrix_conductivity
published_equations.equation_semantics: for h<h_s use a normalized Mualem conductivity based on the modified retention coordinate, with K=K_o at h_s; for h>=h_s set matrix conductivity K_m=K_o
published_equations.normalization_note: The PDF text extraction flattens Eq. 8. The source/Vogel lineage shows that the denominator in Eq. 6 normalizes the Mualem integral at the finite air-entry state so that the conductivity reaches exactly K_o at h_s. Implementation must use the source image or independently verified Vogel formulation rather than a naive F(1)=0 transcription.

published_equations.name: F_function
published_equations.equation: F(x)=[1-x^(1/m)]^m, applied to the modified-retention saturation coordinate used by Eq. 6

published_equations.name: modified_saturation_coordinate
published_equations.equation_semantics: the modified retention uses theta_m in the internal saturation coordinate; the finite air-entry state corresponds to (theta_s-theta_r)/(theta_m-theta_r) < 1
published_equations.role: provides the finite upper integration state used to normalize Eq. 6

published_equations.name: near_saturation_total_conductivity_structure
published_equations.equation: K(h)=A(h)*K_m(h) for h>h_m; K(h)=K_m(h) for h<=h_m
published_equations.role: adds a pressure-dependent near-saturation correction above the matrix-flow relation

published_equations.name: scaled_log_conductivity_residual
published_equations.role: maps the measured-vs-matrix conductivity discrepancy to a dimensionless 0..1 wet-end correction coordinate

published_equations.name: published_piecewise_R
published_equations.role: empirical two-segment wet-end correction fitted to 235 UNSODA conductivity data sets

published_equations.name: published_total_conductivity
endpoint_properties: positive K is preserved for positive K_m and K_s

published_parameter_findings.basis: combined retention and conductivity fitting performance across 235 UNSODA samples
published_parameter_findings.texture_detail: Sands, Loams and Silts had combined optima roughly between -3 and -5 cm; Clays had a broader minimum around -8 cm; the full data set optimum was -4 cm

scientific_caveats_from_primary_source: The near-saturation correction is explicitly empirical, not a mechanistic pore-network derivation.
Near-saturated hydraulic-conductivity measurements are uncertain, so the authors recommend caution.
The apparent micro/meso/macropore interpretation is plausible but not uniquely established by the fitted correction.
The formulation does not explicitly define separate matrix and macropore domains and was not recommended by the authors as a preferential-flow model.

important_distinction_for_SWAP5.statement: Published MMVG is not merely a smooth replacement for the SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM interpolation. It modifies the near-saturation constitutive model and distinguishes a matrix matching point K_o from measured saturated K_s before bridging between them in log-conductivity space.
important_distinction_for_SWAP5.consequence: A faithful MMVG candidate must be exposed as a separate physical hydraulic closure, not hidden inside RossFast numerical policy.

nhi_metaswap_v9_lineage.source: Van Walsum PEV, Kok H, Leander R (2026), MetaSWAP V9 Theory and model implementation, final version 20 March 2026
documented_facts: The NHI/MetaSWAP V9 appendix explicitly cites Schaap and van Genuchten 2006 for heavy-soil near-saturation conductivity problems.
NHI uses a comparatively conservative adjustment starting at -10 cm rather than simply copying the paper's -40/-4/0 cm construction.
The NHI adjustment is implemented through table-form soil hydraulics.

MetaSWAP V9 states that the unmodified table can change conductivity by a factor of about 3 for a volumetric-fraction change of only 0.0001 near saturation and calls this a mathematical artefact rather than an experimental-data feature.
NHI does not represent macropore conductivity through this correction; macropore flow is handled separately through bypass flow, while extra near-saturation retention storage is added separately.
nhi_metaswap_v9_lineage.required_next_source: MetaSWAP Test_report_76 and/or the exact NHI soil-physics table-generation procedure used for Figure A.2

rossfast_candidate_implications: Keep Class A exact SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM evidence unchanged and fail-closed.
Open a separate Class B candidate family for published MMVG and optionally a second Class B candidate for the NHI conservative -10 cm simplification once its exact table mapping is obtained.
Do not combine the published MMVG macropore-inspired conductivity correction with SWAP explicit macropore flow without a double-counting analysis.

Because Eq. 16 is affine in log K between log K_m and log K_s for a prescribed R(h), it is structurally attractive for compact precomputation and interpolation, but this is only a hypothesis until face-response tests pass.

The air-entry plateau may remove the pathological van-Genuchten wet-end slope that motivated the current Ross table difficulties, but transient saturation crossing and storage continuity must be qualified separately.
FullRichards and RossFast must use the same Class B constitutive closure for any solver accuracy comparison.

minimum_metrics: K continuity at h_s and at R-segment joins
Ross steady-face representation error on the frozen O05/O12/O13/B05/O14/B10 stress materials
proposed_next_gate.no_promotion: Passing this constitutive gate would not qualify transient RossFast, groundwater coupling, macropore combinations or production use.
